odd_moments: Divided by nonzero quadratic amplitude lambda before substitution; all coefficients depend on u=lambda^2

mixed_linear.branch: b and transverse linear part both nonzero; normalize b=c1, retain quadratic amplitude lambda; u=lambda^2

transverse_nonisotropic.branch: b0 and a*c nonzero; normalize a=c1, retain quadratic amplitude lambda

transverse_isotropic.branch: b0, nonzero transverse isotropic linear part; normalize c1 and quadratic1; d,e forced units
